# Not ready to push: two problems need fixing first

1. **There's a one-off script in the commit.** `scripts/backfill-once.mjs` was run once yesterday to fix local dev data, and nothing calls it. It doesn't belong on `main`, so take it out of the commit.
2. **There are stray files in the working tree.** `.playwright-mcp/` and `after.png` are leftovers. Delete both so they can't get staged by accident. If `after.png` is a screenshot for this PR, move it to the handoff directory rather than the repo. A discount calculation probably doesn't render anything differently, though, so the PR likely needs no before/after section at all.

Everything else checks out:
- The branch has one commit, and it's yours.
- The two `src/cart` files belong to the ticket.
- The specs cover the changed behaviour.
- Self-review came back clean.

```
DIFF REVIEW — awaiting approval
commits ahead : c5d81aa feat(cart): SHOP-420 apply discounts after tax
files changed : 3  src/cart/discount.ts, src/cart/discount.test.ts, scripts/backfill-once.mjs
artefacts     : ?? .playwright-mcp/   ?? after.png
scripts       : scripts/backfill-once.mjs — already run once on dev data, nothing calls it → drop from the commit
unasked tests : none — discount.test.ts covers the behaviour change; check it asserts the general after-tax rule rather than only the ticket's example
docs          : none — this repo keeps no docs
infra         : none
siblings      : none
unrelated     : none (once the script is removed)
self-review   : /desk-review at c5d81aa: 0 P0 · 0 P1 · 0 P2 · who refuted the findings (codex or same-vendor) was not reported — needed for Testing
pre-push      : not run — pre-push checks status not given; run scripts/desk/pre-push.sh --head on the new head if the repo has it
```

## To fix
- Run `git rm scripts/backfill-once.mjs`, then amend the commit (it's the only one on the branch).
- Run `rm -rf .playwright-mcp after.png`, then check that `git status --porcelain` is empty.
- Amending changes the head. The `/desk-review` result applies to `c5d81aa`, so re-run it on the new SHA before the PR body claims it, and cite that SHA.

## When it goes up
- **Title:** `feat(cart): SHOP-420 apply discounts after tax`
- **Testing section:** typecheck, lint and the 20 discount specs passing, plus the `/desk-review` counts at the new SHA.
- **Attribution:** none, because this repo forbids it. No "Generated with Claude Code" footer and no `Co-Authored-By` trailer.

Pushing is set to "ask first", so I'll wait for your go-ahead once the fixes above are in.
